scope: Studio workspace design and responsive layout, preserving existing app behavior. No new portable operations or target support.
supersedes_scope: Studio layout observations in app-v3-review.json and generated-layer-review.json; their historical behavior and model evidence remain intact.
behavior: Viewport-sized shell with a fitted square canvas, independently scrolling layer stack and inspector, consistent typography, spacing, colors and actions.
Inspector and Prompt tabs retain prompt drafts. Generated layers offer a direct revision shortcut and saved-layer disclosure. Candidate review and Generate/Cancel remain bounded in the editor.
Small screens use dismissible Layers/Inspector/Prompt drawers. Short landscape screens retain the canvas and a scrollable action toolbar.
Searchable project and layer dialogs, separate export dialog, canvas help, keyboard tab navigation and focus restoration.
Canvas retains native 640 by 640 drawing resolution. Document formats, compositor, model coordinator and storage contracts are unchanged.
